AIASSET_ENABLE_REAL_PROVIDERS.description: Master switch. "1" enables real Meshy calls via the 3D gateway; "0" forces the quota-safe mock path.

COS_SECRET_ID.description: Tencent COS SecretId. Empty string clears it.

COS_SECRET_KEY.description: Tencent COS SecretKey. Empty string clears it.

COS_BUCKET.description: COS bucket name (address, not a secret). Empty string clears it.

COS_REGION.description: COS region (address, not a secret). Empty string clears it.

slug.description: Active game slug auto-injected by the workbench host into every tool call; not a credential and ignored by this tool (dropped by the CRED_KEYS whitelist).
